developmentObservations: Native Terraform validate returns valid for an empty directory; original controls require nonempty complete JSON module declarations before execution.
Provider-free native validation checks an undeclared reference in an unused local in another source file without initialization or provider fetches.
A real empty CLI configuration produces no stderr; an earlier prototype using a nonexistent configuration path emitted a warning and is not warning-free acceptance.
The first engine attempt exposed JSON comparison field ordering between parsed module receipts and their expected reconstruction; the normalization was corrected without weakening assertions.

A native missing-tool control preserved its specification and exposed the need to distinguish an exact completed unavailable wrapper receipt from an inconclusive version error. The shared identity classifier and owned version temporary-directory selection were corrected.

Native snippet highlight offsets use UTF-8 bytes. Physical columns count grapheme clusters, as separately measured with accented characters, combining marks and joined emoji. Original broken/repair controls and compiling Unicode regressions bind this behavior.
Actual native version/validation executable identities, arguments and owned cwd are observed before cancellation or source/copied-module changes.
evaluatedPackageScope: The measured tarball contains the evaluated runtime/CLI, schemas and documentation before this receipt. It does not certify a later receipt-containing tarball.
